With (d,d′) nonzero the first two equations impose one independent nonzero functional each, contributing q^2(q^2-1); with both zero they contribute q^4 only when u=v=0. Independently reconstructed literal matrix products and finite-field elimination exhaust all 2^12 and 3^12 input pairs and all q^6 adjoint ranks for q=2,3. These finite checks corroborate, but do not establish, the universal proof.
